ui.app.name: wchron
ui.nav.label: Main navigation
ui.schedules.title: Schedules
ui.schedules.empty: No schedules yet. Creating and editing schedules arrives in a later version.
ui.status.title: Status and log
ui.status.empty: Nothing has run yet. The last runs, errors and the log will show up here.
ui.channels.title: Channels
ui.settings.title: Settings
ui.settings.autostart.hint: Starts minimized to the tray when you sign in.
ui.settings.keepawake.hint: Prevents sleep while wchron is running, so scheduled sends are not missed. The screen can still turn off.
ui.settings.keepawake_default: Keep the PC awake at startup
ui.settings.keepawake_default.hint: Turns keep-awake on every time wchron starts. The switch above changes it only until the next start.
ui.channels.empty: No channel yet. Add one, for example a WhatsApp number, to start sending.
ui.channels.add.title: New channel
ui.channels.add.name: Name
ui.channels.delete.title: Delete channel
ui.channels.delete.confirm: Are you sure you want to delete «{name}»?
ui.channels.delete.consequences: This can't be undone. If the channel is connected, its link is removed from the service first (WhatsApp: the linked device on the phone).
ui.channels.delete.schedules: Its recipients are removed from these schedules:
ui.channels.delete.schedule_disabled: {name}: left without recipients, it will be disabled
ui.channels.delete.error_recipients: Error recipients on this channel removed: {count}
ui.channels.delete.not_logged_out: «{name}» was deleted, but it was not connected, so its link could not be removed from the service: remove it by hand (WhatsApp: Settings → Linked devices on the phone).
ui.channels.logout.title: Log out
ui.channels.logout.confirm: Are you sure you want to log out «{name}»?
ui.channels.logout.consequences: The link is removed from the account (WhatsApp: the linked device on the phone). The channel and its recipients stay; nothing is sent through it until you pair it again.
ui.channels.repair.title: Pair again
ui.channels.repair.confirm: Are you sure you want to pair «{name}» again?
ui.channels.repair.consequences: The current link is removed from the account first, then a new pairing starts. Nothing is sent through the channel until it is paired again.
ui.processor.passthrough.name: Original
ui.processor.passthrough.description: Sends the file as it is
ui.processor.xlsx-snapshot.name: Values only
ui.processor.xlsx-snapshot.description: No formulas or macros, only the chosen sheets
ui.processor.xlsx-snapshot.sheets.hint: One name per row, with dates as in file names. Empty: all sheets.
ui.processor.xlsx-snapshot.read_sheets: Read the sheets from the file
ui.filespec.send_name.hint: Empty: the file's own name. Dates allowed; the extension is added when missing.
provider.whatsapp.name: WhatsApp
provider.whatsapp.tos: wchron connects as an unofficial WhatsApp client (a linked device, like WhatsApp Web). This goes against WhatsApp's terms of service and the account could be restricted or banned: prefer a secondary number.
provider.whatsapp.pair.step2: Go to Settings → Linked devices → Link a device.
provider.whatsapp.pair.step3: Point the phone at this QR code.
provider.whatsapp.pair.expire: The code changes every few seconds and the pairing stops after about two minutes without a scan.
provider.whatsapp.pair.qr_label: QR code to scan with WhatsApp
provider.whatsapp.pair.done: Linked and connected (account {account}). On the phone it shows as “wchron”.
notify.repeat: Same problems as in the previous report: repeated at most every 6 hours while they last.
notify.more: …and {count} more: see Status and log in wchron.
notify.resolved: The send of {slot} went through again, after the problems reported earlier.
notify.failed.title: wchron: error report not delivered
dialog.fatal.title: wchron can't start
error.storage.unavailable: The data folder {path} can't be created or written, so wchron can't start. Check the folder permissions and the free disk space.
error.storage.backup_failed: Backing up the data to {path} failed, so wchron doesn't start, to protect your data. Free some disk space or check the folder permissions.
error.config.read_failed: The configuration file {path} can't be read. wchron doesn't start and leaves the file as it is: restore it from the backups folder.
error.config.write_failed: Couldn't save the configuration to {path}: the change was not applied.
error.config.newer_version: Your data was saved by a newer version of wchron (format {found}; this version supports up to {supported}). wchron doesn't start and doesn't touch it: install the newer version.
error.config.migration_failed: Updating the data format from version {from} to {to} failed. The original files are untouched and backed up.
error.config.invalid: The configuration file {path} has an invalid value in {field}. wchron doesn't start and leaves the file as it is: fix it or restore it from the backups folder.
error.state.read_failed: The last-run information in {path} couldn't be read and was reset (the old file is kept next to it). Schedules keep working.
error.state.write_failed: The last-run information couldn't be saved to {path}.
error.devenv.invalid: Invalid development setting {name}={value}: fix it in .env or in the environment.
error.logs.read_failed: The log files can't be read.
error.token.unclosed: The { at character {pos} is never closed: add the matching }, or write {{ for a literal brace.
error.token.unexpected_close: The } at character {pos} has no matching {: write }} for a literal brace.
error.token.unknown: Unknown token "{name}" at character {pos}: the only token is date, as in {date:DD-MM-YYYY}.
error.token.format_invalid: Invalid date format "{format}" at character {pos}: use the letters YYYY, YY, MMMM, MMM, MM, M, DD, D, dddd, ddd, HH, H, mm, ss.
error.token.offset_invalid: "{offset}" at character {pos} is not a valid date change: use offsets like -1d, +2w, -1m, +1y or anchors like @month-start, @week-end.
error.token.empty: Empty token at character {pos}: write one like {date:DD-MM-YYYY}, or {{}} for literal braces.
error.autostart.failed: Couldn't change the start with Windows setting: Windows refused to write it.
error.keepawake.failed: Windows refused to keep the PC awake.
error.cadence.interval_invalid: The interval must be between 1 minute and 24 hours.
error.cadence.anchor_invalid: "{value}" is not a valid start time: use HH:MM, e.g. 08:30.
error.cadence.window_invalid: The time window must start and end at different times.
error.cadence.window_empty: No send of this interval falls inside the time window: widen the window or change the interval or the start time.
error.cadence.time_invalid: "{value}" is not a valid time: use HH:MM, e.g. 14:00.
error.cadence.time_duplicate: {value} is in the list more than once.
error.slot.missed: {schedule}: skipped sends: {count} (from {from} to {to}), because the PC was asleep or off or the clock changed. They are not recovered.
error.slot.late: {schedule}: the send of {slot} was skipped because it would have started more than 5 minutes late.
error.slot.dst_gap: {schedule}: the send of {slot} was skipped: that time doesn't exist on the day the clocks go forward.
error.slot.dst_repeat: {schedule}: {slot} came round a second time when the clocks went back; it is sent only once.
error.slot.paused: {schedule}: skipped sends: {count} (from {from} to {to}), because the routine was paused.
error.slot.overlap: {schedule}: the send of {slot} was skipped because the previous one was still in progress.
error.channel.provider_unknown: Unknown channel type "{provider}" (configuration edited by hand or written by a newer wchron).
error.channel.not_found: The channel no longer exists: it was deleted meanwhile.
error.channel.not_connected: {channel} is not connected: wait for it to connect and try again.
error.channel.disconnected: {channel} lost the connection; wchron reconnects by itself.
error.channel.targets_failed: The list of groups of {channel} could not be loaded. Try again.
error.channel.logout_failed: Logging out {channel} failed. Check the connection and try again; you can also remove the linked device from the phone.
error.recipient.check_unavailable: {channel} is not connected, so this recipient can't be checked now. It is saved as not verified and checked when the channel connects.
error.recipient.target_invalid: A field of the recipient on {channel} is missing or wrong ({field}).
error.recipient.check_failed: {recipient} on {channel} failed the check when the channel connected: it won't receive anything until you fix it.
error.wa.number_invalid: "{value}" is not a valid international number: write it with + and the country code, e.g. +39 333 1234567.
error.wa.group_not_found: The group {name} is no longer among the groups of {channel} (left or removed).
error.wa.client_outdated: WhatsApp rejected this version of wchron on {channel}. Install the update when it is offered.
error.wa.logged_out: {channel} was logged out (the linked device was removed from the phone or expired). Pair it again from the Channels page.
error.wa.pair_timeout: The QR codes for {channel} expired without a scan. Start again.
error.wa.pair_failed: Pairing {channel} failed or was refused. Start again.
error.wa.session_corrupt: The saved WhatsApp session of {channel} couldn't be opened: it was set aside and the channel needs a new pairing.
error.wa.stream_replaced: {channel} was disconnected because the same WhatsApp session was opened elsewhere (for example a copy of wchron with the same data). Close the other one, then restart wchron.
error.wa.temporary_ban: WhatsApp temporarily blocked the account of {channel}. wchron doesn't reconnect it by itself: wait, then restart wchron.
error.send.not_connected: {schedule}: not sent to {recipient}, because {channel} was not connected.
error.send.too_large: {schedule}: {file} ({size}) is larger than {channel} allows ({max}); not sent to that recipient.
error.send.upload_failed: {schedule}: uploading {file} for {recipient} failed, also after a retry.
error.send.failed: {schedule}: sending {file} to {recipient} failed, also after a retry.
error.send.recipient_invalid: {schedule}: the service rejected {recipient} (number deactivated, removed from the group…).
error.schedule.not_found: The schedule no longer exists: it was deleted meanwhile.
error.schedule.busy: {name} is already sending: wait for it to finish.
error.recipient.channel_missing: {schedule}: {recipient} was skipped because its channel no longer exists.
error.filespec.path_required: Enter the path of the file.
error.filespec.path_not_absolute: "{value}" is not a full path: start it with the drive (C:…) or the network share (\server…).
error.filespec.glob_in_dir: "{value}": the wildcards * and ? are allowed only in the file name, not in the folders.
error.processor.unknown: Unknown file processing "{type}" (configuration edited by hand or written by a newer wchron).
error.processor.options_invalid: A processing option is missing or wrong ({field}).
error.filespec.send_name_invalid: "{value}" can't be used as a file name: remove the characters < > : " / \ | ? *, a dot or space at the end, or names reserved by Windows such as CON.
error.xlsx.not_xlsx: {value} is not an Excel workbook in .xlsx or .xlsm format (old .xls files are not supported): choose "Original" to send it as it is.
error.xlsx.open_failed: {schedule}: {file} can't be opened as an Excel workbook (damaged, or protected by a password), so it was not sent.
error.xlsx.sheet_missing: {schedule}: the sheet "{sheet}" is not in {file}; the file was sent with the other sheets.
error.xlsx.no_sheet_found: {schedule}: none of the sheets {sheets} is in {file}, so it was not sent.
error.xlsx.no_cached_values: {schedule}: in {file}, sheet {sheet}, {count} formulas had no saved value (file not saved by Excel): those cells are empty.
error.xlsx.process_failed: {schedule}: making the values-only copy of {file} failed, so it was not sent.
error.file.not_found: {schedule}: no file matches {path} now. It is tried again at the next send.
error.file.multiple_matches: {schedule}: {count} files match {path}. Choose "newest" or "all", or make the name stricter.
error.file.locked: {schedule}: {file} is locked by another program (for example while it is being saved), so it was not sent.
error.file.unreadable: {schedule}: {file} can't be read (access denied or read error), so it was not sent.
error.temp.unavailable: {schedule}: the temporary folder can't be written, so nothing was sent.
error.send.caption_too_long: {schedule}: the caption is longer than {channel} allows ({max} characters); not sent to {recipient}.
error.send.files_unsupported: {schedule}: {channel} can't send files; nothing sent to {recipient}.
error.notify.failed: The error report could not be sent to {recipient}.
error.internal: Unexpected error. The details are in the log.
